members.prompt:
You are code-cleaner on team r101-paradigm-shift. Use Opus 4.6 for all work.

Read the team context: ~/.claude/teams/r101-paradigm-shift/team-context.md

YOUR TASK (Task #4): Fix exactly 4 verified bugs. NO other changes. EXPERIMENT FREEZE in effect.

BUG 1: Word-boundary comp matching (src/agent/dispatch.py around line 245)
Current code: `any(word in query_lower for word in _COMP_INTENT_WORDS)`
Problem: "comp" matches "comparison", "complete", "accomplish", "uncompromising"
Fix: Use word-boundary matching. Split query into word tokens and check membership:
```python
query_words = set(re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', query_lower))
if query_words & _COMP_INTENT_WORDS:
```
You'll need to import `re` at the top of dispatch.py if not already imported.

BUG 2: Remove dead code (src/agent/nodes.py around line 274)
Function `_get_routed_llm` is defined but never called anywhere in the codebase.
Remove the entire function definition. Verify with grep first that it has zero callers.

BUG 3: Fix log message (src/agent/graph.py line 321)
Current: `logger.info("Custom 12-node StateGraph compiled successfully.")`
Fix: Change "12-node" to "13-node" (the graph has 13 nodes as documented in line 1 and 166)

BUG 4: Remove stale field reference (src/agent/profiling.py around line 251)
The tuple `relationship_fields` at line 249-254 still includes "companion_names".
Line 182 documents that companion_names was removed from the schema in R76.
Remove "companion_names" from the tuple.

AFTER ALL FIXES, verify:
1. grep -rn "_get_routed_llm" src/ (should return 0 hits)
2. grep -n "companion_names" src/agent/profiling.py (should only be comment at ~182)
3. Run: cd /home/odedbe/projects/hey-seven && python -m pytest tests/test_nodes.py tests/test_graph_v2.py tests/test_profiling.py -x -q --timeout=30

Update your section in ~/.claude/teams/r101-paradigm-shift/team-memory.md when done.
